defensives.name: Guardian Spirit
defensives.usage_rule: Use as your main tank external to prevent a lethal hit (cheat death restoring the target to 40% health); coordinate with the tank, and self-cast it if no tank needs it since Priest is otherwise weak defensively.

defensives.name: Desperate Prayer
defensives.usage_rule: Press when your health drops toward 75% or below, especially after self-damage like Shadow Word: Death, to instantly heal yourself and raise your maximum health for the window.

defensives.name: Fade
defensives.usage_rule: Use to shed threat and, with the Greater Fade or damage-reduction talents, to mitigate an incoming hit or shrug off a mechanic; keep it available for emergencies.
